verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS product like Trello, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out setting. The community remarks about privacy concern account management and board membership, not telemetry, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
